selected_guidance.selected_prompt: Keeping [quality and ease of use] intact, what would it take to expand [current scope] to [ten times the scope]? How much work would that require, why, and is it reasonable? Which costs come from the underlying design?
selected_guidance.decisive_use_note: Use one actual addition to ground the estimate: where must someone edit, check, reconnect or recover? State assumptions instead of inventing precise costs.
selected_guidance.ten_times_interpretation: A growth probe, not a requirement to manufacture ten times the content or invent a precise large-scale cost estimate.

trial.question: Can a normal owner edit add a domain rule without loading that rule for unrelated work, and what recovery coupling remains?
before_observation_expectations: Adding a rule inside an unselected domain should leave the no-concern closure unchanged.
Selecting Time and calendar should add the complete time unit and explicit concern-routing dependency, with no unrelated demo or frontend unit.
A backend-only edit in the shared development file may change file identity while leaving the development-core body identity unchanged; old digest recovery should be checked rather than assumed.
trial.contamination_limits: Only six named public Markdown files were copied. No historical evidence or parent plan was copied. The CLI implementation stayed the current repository implementation; --root directed document reads to the disposable tree.

disposable_additions.time:
### Preserve an explicit calendar boundary in exported summaries

A summary exported for another system declares which calendar and date boundary its labels use. The consumer must not reconstruct that boundary from its own host defaults. This paragraph is a disposable reader-routing probe only.
disposable_additions.backend:
### Keep one operation identity through a rejected duplicate

A rejected duplicate operation exposes the original operation identity so a caller can inspect the already accepted result. This paragraph is a disposable reader-routing probe only.
disposable_additions.status: Source-shaped payloads in existing normative owner copies, used solely to test reader granularity. No claim that either should be adopted as a new rule.

old_core_recovery_after_backend_edit.stderr: read_rules: docs/contracts/development-discipline.md: expected file digest changed; rerun prepare

observations.body_identity_basis: Compared every ordered (unit identity, SHA-256 body hash) pair in the no-concern manifest before and after each domain edit, rather than comparing unit count alone.

interpretation.fact: The no-concern closure stayed nine units / 92,501 body bytes. Selecting Time and calendar added exactly its 4,539-byte unit. A 298-byte addition inside that unit grew the selected closure by exactly 298 bytes and did not grow ordinary startup.
interpretation.supported_strength: Explicit conditional reading units can keep inactive domain bodies out of normal task context as domain content grows. This trial supports that mechanism for these existing units only.
interpretation.cost_and_boundary: The fixed current core is already substantial. A backend-only edit in the shared development file also invalidated old digest recovery of its unchanged core unit. The documented whole-file identity protects metadata and boundary changes; this is an intended transaction trade-off, not automatically a harness defect.
interpretation.reuse_limit: The trial does not establish that unchanged retained units must be reread. A fresh manifest can show the body hash remains unchanged; task context permits reuse while digest, scope and retained context remain valid.
interpretation.unmeasured: No many-domain benchmark, semantic rule-completeness review, overall selection-accuracy measurement, reader-time baseline, quota-cost estimate, or comparative guidance effectiveness test was run.

diagnosis_and_useful_next_action.action: For the next genuinely distinct domain addition, keep its operative body at its existing or new proper domain owner, declare only its necessary reading edges, and repeat a no-concern versus selected-domain closure check. Preserve semantic completeness and exceptions rather than shrinking units to hit a size target.
diagnosis_and_useful_next_action.why_this_advances_the_goal: It preserves the observed ability to add relevant detail without forcing inactive domain prose into every ordinary task, while checking what a real recipient will actually receive.
diagnosis_and_useful_next_action.recovery_action: When a file edit invalidates a partial read, rerun prepare and use the resulting identities before resuming. Consider separating current shared-file domain owners only if repeated recovery churn proves material; preserve whole-file transaction safety rather than weakening digest checks.
diagnosis_and_useful_next_action.alternative: Leave the current file topology intact when domain edits are rare. A split introduces link, dependency and provenance migration work; this trial does not establish that paying that cost now is worthwhile.
diagnosis_and_useful_next_action.who_bears_cost: The executing agent and indirectly the owner through context, tool use and interruption costs; only emitted bytes and one rejected recovery were measured. Large-scale impact remains unknown.

guidance_assessment.bounded_verdict: The presented guidance was usable without private owner history for this diagnosis. The growth starter supplied a concrete distinguishing observation, the task recipe kept the claim bounded, and the core preserved read-only authority and a direct lookup route.
guidance_assessment.observed_help: The growth use note led to an actual addition and its next command, producing a useful distinction between inactive-domain body growth and whole-file recovery coupling. This supports utility in this use; there is no control trial to attribute all success to the guide.
ambiguities: The optional real-task recipe suggests a normal contract copy for templates, while this task concerns maintaining the template itself. I adapted it to a domain-owner edit and labeled that narrower plumbing test.
The growth starter is a probe, not a quantified scaling forecast. The guide makes that explicit.
guidance_assessment.rescue: No parent rescue, private history, additional permissions or unavailable-tool workaround was needed. Truncated output was recovered through the published complete-reading protocol. Parent messages later identified concurrent wording edits; they did not supply the selected question or expected verdict.
